/bin/bash -lc "python3 -c \"
import pandas as pd, re
df_raw=pd.read_excel('field_visit_log.xlsx', header=None)
header_row=4
cols=df_raw.iloc[header_row].tolist()
data=df_raw.iloc[header_row+1:].copy()
data.columns=cols
# keep relevant columns
keep=['Visit ID','Village','Women Reached','Men Reached','Children Reached']
df=data[keep].copy()
# drop rows where Visit ID is NaN
df=df.dropna(subset=['Visit ID'])
# deduplicate Visit ID keep first
df=df.drop_duplicates(subset=['Visit ID'], keep='first')
def normalize(v):
    if pd.isna(v): return ''
    s=str(v).strip()
    s=re.sub(r'\\s+',' ',s)
    return s.lower()
df['village_norm']=df['Village'].apply(normalize)
# ensure numeric
for c in ['Women Reached','Men Reached','Children Reached']:
    df[c]=pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors='coerce').fillna(0)
df['total_people']=df['Women Reached']+df['Men Reached']+df['Children Reached']
group=df.groupby('village_norm')['total_people'].sum()
print(group.sort_values(ascending=False).head(10))
\""
